children: TeraWulf Inc. (WULF) stock closed at its lowest weekly level in at least six months on Friday. This continued a drop that has wiped out more than 60% of the stock's value since June. The company announced it increased its senior secured revolving credit facility by about 60% to about $400 million. This gives the company more borrowing power as it builds data centers for AI clients.

Morgan Stanley Arranges TeraWulf’s Key Financings

Morgan Stanley has been a key lender in TeraWulf's growth. In October 2025, the bank was the only bookrunner for a $3.2 billion senior secured notes offering by subsidiary WULF Compute. The money raised helped pay for part of an expansion of the company's data center at its Lake Mariner campus in New York.
Morgan Stanley is also the administrative agent on a separate $500 million, 364-day delayed-draw bridge facility, which finances TeraWulf’s data center in Hawesville, Kentucky.
